title: Unlabelled icon buttons, sub-minimum targets, disabled font scaling, low contrast, module-scope Dimensions
notes: #AAAAAA on #FFFFFF is about 2.3:1 — well under the 4.5:1 AA requirement for body text. A good agent computes or at least asserts the failure rather than saying 'consider checking contrast'.

flags touch targets below the 44/48 minimum

flags the destructive delete action lacking confirmation or a distinct label

treats the icon component name as sufficient labelling
asserts a contrast ratio without it being computable from the given colours
